entries.b9eff50602f323a1: A business that operates drugstores stocking consumables essential to daily life, such as pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, sundries and general foods. The Group operates in a single segment of retail sales of pharmaceuticals and cosmetics, and as of the end of May 2026 ran 1,708 stores across the Kanto, Chubu, Kansai, Chugoku, Shikoku and Kyushu regions (673 in Kyushu, 244 in Kansai, 229 in Chugoku, 202 in Kanto, 201 in Chubu and 159 in Shikoku). The management philosophy is “We aim to enrich the daily lives of the local community through the presence of COSMOS Pharmaceutical stores,” and the Group is expanding its store network under the “Mainichi Yasui” (Everyday Low Price) policy and its original “small-trading-area mega drugstore” strategy. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥1,099,583 million (up 8.7% year on year), driven by active new store openings and implementation of the “Mainichi Yasui” policy. The Group consists of COSMOS Pharmaceutical Corporation and its consolidated subsidiary Gurīn Furasshu Co., Ltd., which carries out comprehensive maintenance management of the Group’s stores and is certified as a special subsidiary for the employment of persons with disabilities. In addition, there is the consolidated subsidiary Kosumosu Kōporēshon Co., Ltd., which is in effect a dormant company. Because the Group has a single segment, revenue is not disclosed separately by business; the 5 categories below are sales results by product category.
